items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: my uncle, Dui Shmead... used to always encourage me, you know, and show me little tricks and chords

ctx.x: Did you have a formal teacher that taught you?

Well, I started off, like I say, with my mother. And, of course, my uncle, Dui Shmead, who was known as Wilbur Leroy, and show business, he was a vaudeville, I can't. He played a little fake piano, you know. And he used to always encourage me, you know, and show me little tricks and chords and things that he used to know. And, of course, I know that all of this was a great incentive for me, but somehow or another, I don't know how to explain this, but I just didn't know anything else. It's the only thing I knew.…
Now, was ragtime the popular style piano then? Would you say that?
